name: Cover: readout
description: An instrument-panel cover: a monospaced kicker with a short colour bar top left, the title across the left two thirds, a readout frame holding the subtitle bottom right and a ruler along the bottom. A centred title slide would lose the instrument vocabulary of a readout area.

kicker.hint: occasion or series name, 4 to 12 characters; Latin letters and digits are set in monospace

title.hint: claim headline, 1 to 2 lines, up to 16 characters

subtitle.hint: one fact that supports the claim, shown in the readout frame bottom right, up to 50 characters

subtitle.value: Last quarter six decks averaged four rounds; three of them touched only layout.
